title: Vigil for Charles McGillivary
article: Friends and family members of Charles McGillivary will gather at Bloor and Christie streets for a vigil a week after he died in an altercation with police.The 45-year-old man collapsed while being arrested by Toronto police while walking with his mother in the area.McGillivary's mother was in a local pizza shop getting pizza when what the Toronto Police special investigations unit called a "physical interaction" between police and McGillivary took place on the street.According to McGillivary's mother, the man suffered brain damage when he was hit by a car as a child. He was unable to speak due to the accident.The special investigations unit is looking into the incident and said in a release that police had been conducting an investigation in the area. The vigil will take place tonight (Monday, Aug. 8) at 8 p.m. at the southwest corner of Bloor and Christie streets.
